reviews.author: Jason Vilimas
reviews.text: Don’s Auto repaired my clutch in 2020, and all the services and issues since. They will always review the costs before performing any of the work, completely transparent. Great service, honest prices, a great family business!

reviews.author: Craig P
reviews.text: OUTSTANDING REPAIR SHOP!! Being 400 miles from home with a blown brake line, I had no idea who was going to fix my problem. After speaking with several people in town (S.H.) one person referred me to Don's Auto Repair in Goshen, so that's where I went. From the moment I pulled into there driveway I knew I picked the right place. After explaining my situation to them they took me right in and a few hours later I was all fixed up and headed back to finish out the rest of my vacation. I would highly recommend Don's to anyone in or around the area. TOP NOTCH FROM START TO FINISH!!

reviews.author: Edward Young
reviews.text: Great people. I brought my WRX here and had a new intake, cat back, strut brace and oil change all done in one day for a fair price! Highly recommend this place.

reviews.author: Mark Brodwater
reviews.text: Don’s Auto Repair came highly recommended by a good friend and coworker and they did not disappoint. I have an older Nissan Altima that required some extensive brake work and exhaust work as well. Not only were all repairs done in a timely fashion, the price was right-communication was spot on and the work done exceeded my expectations. Car never handled this good! Cannot recommend them enough. Thanks Dons for great reasonable trustworthy service.

reviews.author: WILDWOOD ‘S WAY!
reviews.text: a family owned company which has many years experience repairing all sorts of cars and trucks. I have complete trust in their expertise in working on my cars. My friends go here as well and they are reasonable with prices and take pride in their work ethics. They are located in goshen area and easy to find.

reviews.author: Kenneth Grant
reviews.text: Had a weird pulsing through the truck like my abs was kicking in. Went there fearing the worst. They road tested the truck put it on the lift and got back to me with an estimate for a new rear wheel bearing. Gave the ok and ah hour or so later call to say all ready and the cost was below the already fair estimated price. I am a visitor from. Montréal and it's great to have a place when in the Cape May area that I can rely on and trust for my older truck. Great honest and professional team with friendly and quick service. Would give more than 5 stars if I could.

reviews.author: Dan Young
reviews.text: The staff at Don’s Auto has kept my work and personal vehicles in top shape for years. And have always handled all of our services professionally and priced fairly. I tell everyone to go to them.

reviews.author: Peter Crafts
reviews.text: They are very reasonably priced, professional, and pay close attention to detail at all times. I highly recommend them as a family owned business.

reviews.author: Tim Truman
reviews.text: Don and the entire team are fantastic. Work is priced fairly and honestly. Good neighbors, good people in a good community!

reviews.author: Marie Quigley
reviews.text: I broke down 13 miles away from my home, was given a referral to Don's Auto, they were extremely pleasant, professional and got me up and running in a week.

reviews.author: Courtney Harris
reviews.text: They weren't able to help me with my car but the owner was extremely helpful and friendly. He was able to point me in the correct direction! Thank you!!

reviews.author: Robert Pasroria
reviews.text: Very satisfied with all work performed. Staff is very friendly and efficient and prices are fair and affordable

reviews.author: Diane Seymour
reviews.text: Reasonably priced, fast service, professional and friendly staff. Highly recommend. Good bye Kindle!
